summary: You write a token-aware splitter: whole sentences are packed into chunks that fit a token budget, and a hard split by tokens is the last resort. Three tests hold the promises (every chunk fits, no text is lost, a bad budget is rejected). You also write note 1 of your module 3 checkpoint: how tokens limit your assistant.
goal: Split documents into chunks that fit a token budget, prove it with tests, and write note 1 of your module 3 checkpoint.

items.text: Part A: write down the Chunk fields, the two promises and what happens to an oversized sentence
Part B: write split_text with sentence packing and a hard-split fallback
Part C: add Chunk and chunk_documents, and match the three budget lines
Part D: write three tests and see them pass, with mypy clean
Part E: hard-split Thai text, see it cut inside a word, then try a budget of 0
Part F: write note 1 with your own numbers, then update the README, commit and push
Play the Chunk Referee game to the end and see your score
